changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwcountry AS SELECT c.id, c.name, c.code, c.is_active, c.created_by, c.created_date, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_date FROM public.country c;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwcountry TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwcountry FROM report_user;
